theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (y : Rn n) (ρ r α c : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ((∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∀ z' ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖ρ • g (y + ρ • z) - ρ • g (y + ρ • z')‖ ≤ c * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) ↔ ∀ x ∈ ball y (ρ * r), ∀ x' ∈ ball y (ρ * r), ρ ^ (1 + α) * ‖g x - g x'‖ ≤ c * ‖x - x'‖ ^ α)
